## motivated-ostrich

### Description and Rationale
I am an aeronautics student specializing in data science, currently studying between Centrale Lille and Cranfield University. Throughout my studies, I have had the opportunity to work on a variety of data science and machine learning projects, ranging from healthcare applications and hospital tools to more advanced topics such as Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) applied on the A320.

I decided to take part in the PRC Data Challenge to put my experience to the test on a new and challenging problem. I am motivated by the opportunity to push the limits of my current skills, explore new approaches, and learn from the challenge. I also see it as a great opportunity to apply the knowledge I have gained through my previous projects in a competitive and practical environment.
